name: The Folded Coast
difficulty_label: Medium: folding gates, ink pools and paper fans
description: A world folded from a lost atlas. Cross accordion-paper bridges above a dark ink sea, climb cliffs of stacked pages, explore origami groves and ink-filled tide cups, then face the Cartographer on its printed chart terrace. Paired folds carry players and shots. The travelling merchant is a visitor from the heroes’ realm.
